name: WoW Panel
author: Plinth
description: Token price with its own recorded trend, the weekly reset countdown, this week's Mythic+ affixes, and your character's item level and rating.

properties.name: clientId
properties.label: Battle.net client ID
properties.placeholder: From develop.battle.net — needed for the token price
properties.help: Create a client at develop.battle.net → API Access. Both the id and the secret are needed, and only for the WoW Token price — the character and affix panels work without them.

properties.name: clientSecret
properties.label: Battle.net client secret
properties.help: The client secret for that same Battle.net application. It buys a short-lived token for the token-price call and is never sent anywhere else.
